responsibility: Declares the early macro-oriented AST visitor used before full Rust name resolution. EarlyNameResolver maintains the current lexical/macro scope, offers scoped execution helpers for pushing and popping macro ribs safely, and provides visit hooks over the full AST so macro definitions and invocations embedded in items, expressions, types, patterns, imports, and generic arguments can be discovered and connected prior to the main resolver pass.
same_name_distinction: Declares the EarlyNameResolver ASTVisitor, its scoped helper for pushing/popping macro ribs, the current/crate scope state it carries, and the large set of visit methods it can override. It differs from rust-early-name-resolver.cc by defining the visitor interface and scope-management utility, not the per-node traversal and macro-resolution implementation.
